changes: Added four explicitly fictional scenes: a family gift, hidden savings, long burial and a later royal collection.

Added four scoped references, for twelve companion references; preserved the main atlas sources, image records and reuse-review flags.
Preserved the existing design, native scrolling, photographs and documented specimen record.

visualReview: Authenticated preview: original obverse and reverse photographs, fiction introduction and first scenes.

limitations: The story is historical fiction, not provenance for NGC 2086328-049. Its ancient findspot and ownership remain unknown.
The Milne opening primary paragraph was checked in an indexed scan; the full page image could not be retrieved. Its historical condition language is not a modern grade.
Targeted Chromium checks; not Safari/Firefox, screen-reader, actual browser zoom or real-device touch certification.

The four companion photographs were reverified. Main atlas remote photographs were not re-audited in this content-only update; see the preceding one-owl-release-qa.json for their last full hosted check.
The owner’s existing decision to retain six BnF photographs with review notices remains in effect. No new rights clearance or publication decision.
